items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: I think I agree with Mat when he says it’s all good music.

ctx.x: You have to define somehow. I mean Arbors, his brochure says classic jazz and that gives you some information. But you can’t publish a paper called The Rag.

You have to define it and you have to respect the various genres too. That’s the other part of it. I think I agree with Mat when he says it’s all good music. But you don’t sell it based on it’s all good music. In the same, Wycliffe saying can’t it all be considered jazz, but it really can’t because people have their favorites and they have their favorite genre and they’re so different. They all fall under the umbrella of improvisation up to a point until you get into the really arranged materials that you get in…
